svg.title: OTLP forwarder over CloudWatch Logs
svg.desc: The Lambda functions send spans over CloudWatch Logs to the OTLP forwarder, which exports them to an OTLP endpoint, through the ROTel extension to ClickHouse, or with SigV4 to the account's Transaction Search. At cold start, the forwarder reads its OTLP headers from Secrets Manager for the OTLP exporter, and the ROTel extension reads the ClickHouse credentials for the ClickHouse exporter.
